description: OpenAI Responses API checks (responses profile, basic only in v0.1). The models.* checks from chat.json also run.

checks.title: POST /responses returns object=response with an output array

body.input: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Implement POST /v1/responses with {"object":"response","status":"completed","output":[{"type":"message","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"..."}]}]}. Codex-style clients need this endpoint, not chat completions.

checks.title: Response reports usage.input_tokens / output_tokens
checks.fix_hint: The Responses API names usage fields input_tokens/output_tokens (not prompt_tokens/completion_tokens). Translate them when proxying chat-completions upstreams.

checks.title: Stream runs response.created ... response.completed with usage

body.input: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Emit typed events (event: response.created, response.output_text.delta, ..., response.completed) with data.type equal to the event name; put usage in the final response object.

checks.title: Unknown model gives 4xx with a JSON error message

body.input: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return 400/404 with {"error":{"message":"...","type":"invalid_request_error"}}; never an HTML page or a 5xx.
